subject: CS351
filterSummary: Selected 10 videos covering 5 key topics in Operating Systems deadlocks. For English, selections from top educational channels like Gate Smashers and Jenny's Lectures were prioritized for their high view counts and detailed explanations. For Arabic, selections from Dr. Ahmed Hagag and Mustafa S. Aljumaily were chosen for their academic rigor and popularity. All selected videos are highly relevant, meet quality gates, and directly address the specified student difficulties for each topic.

videos.title: L-4.5: Deadlock Avoidance Banker's Algorithm with Example |With English Subtitles
videos.filter_reason: Most viewed and comprehensive step-by-step guide on the topic from a highly reputable channel, perfect for students struggling with the calculations.
